text:
Jamal: Quick ping — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7191 is blocking tonight's roll-forward. It needs two reviewer sign-offs before the 23:00 UTC rollout. @sophie @maria can you take a quick pass?

sophie: On it, will skim now :eyes:

release-bot: Reminder: deployment window opens 2026-03-17 23:00 UTC. Merge freeze in place 15m before window.

maria: What's the blocking item? CI shows one flaky test in integration/socket_timeouts. If it's just retry ordering I can push a fix.

Jamal: Only failing on `TestSocketRetry` — stack trace below:
```
---- TestSocketRetry ----
assertion failed: expected 3 retries, got 2
at retry.go:47
at socket_test.go:129
```
That looks like timing/retry ordering.

sophie: I can do review +1 for the change if maria pushes the test fix. I'm tied up for ~10m.

maria: Pushed fix to branch `fix/socket-retry-flake` (force-push). Small reorder + added a short backoff in the test. Running local CI: `./scripts/ci-local --test TestSocketRetry`.

Jamal: Thanks. @oliver can you confirm dual sign-off policy? Once sophie approves and oliver gives final okay I'll merge.

oliver: Confirmed — two independent reviewer sign-offs required for release-critical PRs. I'll review now, aiming to +1 within 20m. If both sign-offs present by 22:50 UTC I'll cut the merge.

sophie: Reviewed and left a minor comment, approving after maria addresses it. :thumbsup:

maria: Addressed comment and force-pushed. All green on CI now.

release-bot: CI passed for commit abc123 on PR 7191. Merge queue position: 3. Auto-merge scheduled when approvals satisfied.

Jamal: Both approvals in — sophie & oliver. Merging now. Thanks team :rocket:
